name: Flagongut's Fossil
summary: At the Wetlands dig, Flagongut seeks answers in an ancient fossil. The Explorers' League keeps the specimen, and Flagongut believes the Stone of Relu can help him decipher its secrets.

sections.title: Excavation and Study
sections.body: Prospector Whelgar keeps the fossil at his excavation site in the southern hills of the Wetlands. Dwarven expeditions across Khaz Modan unearthed it, and Archaeologist Flagongut believes its ancient stone holds forgotten powers. He sees a kinship with artifacts found across the sea in Darkshore.

sections.title: Unlocking the Relic
sections.body: Flagongut found the Stone of Relu and recognized it as the key to deciphering the fossil. Mottled raptors ambushed him on the road, and the stone was lost. Now Flagongut needs the fossil from Whelgar's dig and the stone recovered from the Wetlands wildlife to unlock the specimen.

faq.answer: Flagongut's Fossil is an ancient specimen recovered from the Wetlands. The dwarven Explorers' League keeps it for analysis of the world's ancient past.
The fossil lies in a cave at the top of Whelgar's Excavation Site in the southern mountains of the Wetlands. Mottled raptors that overran the dig guard it.

faq.q: Why does Flagongut need it returned?
aliases: what will flagongut do with it
faq.answer: Flagongut believes the Stone of Relu can help him decipher the fossil's hidden magical secrets and compare it with similar findings in Kalimdor.

faq.q: How is it connected to Darkshore?
faq.answer: Flagongut sees a parallel between the Wetlands specimen and the fossil found by Prospector Remtravel in Darkshore. He believes the Stone of Relu might unlock the power in both relics.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see fossils such as Flagongut's as links to the ancient past. The Explorers' League is dedicated to unearthing them.
As an Alliance member, you can help secure artifacts from Whelgar's ruined dig site before wild beasts destroy them or hostile forces scavenge them in the marsh.
